'''Monique Teillaud''' is a French researcher in [[computational geometry]] at the [[French Institute for Research in Computer Science and Automation]] (INRIA) in [[Nancy, France]]. She moved to Nancy in 2014 from a different INRIA center in [[Sophia Antipolis]],{{r|portrait}} where she was one of the developers of [[CGAL]], a software library of computational geometry algorithms.{{r|inria}}

Teillaud graduated from the ''École Normale Supérieure de Jeunes Filles'' in 1985, she then got a position at [[École nationale supérieure d'informatique pour l'industrie et l'entreprise]] before moving to [[Inria]] in 1989. She completed her Ph.D. in 1991 at [[Paris-Sud University]] under the supervision of [[Jean-Daniel Boissonnat]].{{r|mgp}} 
She was the 2008 program chair of the [[Symposium on Computational Geometry]].{{r|socg}}
She is also the author or editor of two books in computational geometry:
*''Towards Dynamic Randomized Algorithms in Computational Geometry'' ([[Lecture Notes in Computer Science]] 758, Springer, 1993){{r|tdra}}
*''Effective Computational Geometry for Curves and Surfaces'' (edited with Boissonat, Springer, 2007)
